slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that same year, or does each training jet produce a different number of pilots (for example, multiple pilots per jet or a fixed pilot count per jet)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked how many pilots each training jet produces per year, directly covering the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when the training program starts or how many years training lasts. Turn 2 only asked about whether newly produced jets can be used for training in the same year, not about the training program's start year or duration.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and runs through year 2, so pilots can be trained in both years and counted cumulatively by the end of year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training program's start year or duration, yet its READY_TO_MODEL formulation assumes training occurs in years 1 and 2.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 training-capacity slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 training start/duration slot remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the key per-jet training capacity, but it stopped before clarifying the training program's start year and duration, silently assuming a two-year training timeline.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
